findings.claim: The Luma fallback does not implement the promised whole-word city match and classifies Colima as Peru.
findings.evidence: A mocked offline Luma event for Colima, Mexico with valid Colima coordinates and no country_code returned country PE because matchCity uses haystacks.includes('lima').
findings.layer: Luma API response to census-country pipeline

findings.claim: The census keeps counting pin types hidden by the existing map filters.
findings.evidence: The production UI started with 20 markers and census total 20. Hiding SHIPPED reduced the map to 16 markers while the census stayed at 20 and retained shipped country counts.
findings.layer: map-filter state to rendered census contract

findings.claim: The pending PinturilloElements pin is misclassified as Chile when combined with this PR.
findings.evidence: The two PRs merge without a text conflict, but resolvePinCountry sees 'Santiago' first in 'Santiago de Surco, Lima, Perú' and returns CL. Combined stats show CL 1 and leave Peru at 11. The new country field is optional and PR #4 does not set it.

findings.claim: README does not mention the new census feature.
findings.evidence: The repository's Features section is the public product surface, while neither app/page.tsx nor components/stats-panel.tsx is accompanied by a README update.

exemptions.claim: The existing repository-wide Biome failures are not caused by PR #3.
exemptions.evidence: The same three errors reproduce on PR #4, which changes only data/main.json, while all PR #3 changed files pass Biome.
